claim_text: McDonald's Japan says a third party got unauthorized access to customer information in its official app's database
summary: McDonald's Japan says it has confirmed 'unauthorized access by a third party' to part of the customer information in the database of its official app.
detail: The notice, dated Nov 20, 2026, uses the words 'unauthorized access' (不正アクセス). It does not use the words 'cyberattack' or 'attack'.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The company's own notice states it; The Record reports the same from the notice.
notes: Quoted words are our translation from the Japanese.

claim_text: Purchase history, an internal customer ID, IP addresses and phone location data were involved
summary: McDonald's Japan lists the information targeted: purchase history, a customer management ID used inside its systems, IP addresses, and location data from the mobile device used when a service was provided.
detail: The company says the customer management ID cannot identify a customer on its own and is different from the app member ID and the customer's email address.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The notice lists the four kinds of information; The Record reports the same list.

claim_text: McDonald's Japan says names, email addresses, phone numbers, addresses and card details were not included
summary: The company says the information did not include the name, email address, phone number, address or credit card details that customers registered in the app.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: The company's own statement, repeated by The Record. No one outside the company has checked it, so Reported.

claim_text: How many customers were affected is not known
summary: McDonald's Japan has not said how many app users or records were involved. The Record says the company has not disclosed how many customers were affected.
label: Not established
why_it_supports: The notice gives no number and The Record says none was given.

claim_text: Whether the information was copied out is not known
summary: The notice says the information was the target of unauthorized access, but does not say whether any of it was copied or taken. The Record says it remains unclear whether the attacker stole any customer information.
label: Not established

claim_text: When the access happened and when it was found is not known
summary: The notice, dated Nov 20, does not say when the unauthorized access began or when it was discovered. The Record says the company has not disclosed when the intrusion occurred.
label: Not established
why_it_supports: Neither source gives a date for the access.

claim_text: The access used login credentials that McDonald's Japan is now cancelling
summary: McDonald's Japan says it is invalidating the authentication credentials that were used for the unauthorized access.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The company's own notice states the step; The Record reports it.

claim_text: How the credentials were obtained is not known
summary: McDonald's Japan has not said how the credentials used in the access were obtained. The Record says the company did not explain how they were obtained.
label: Not established

claim_text: McDonald's Japan says it has found no misuse and app users need take no special steps
summary: The company says no unauthorized use of the official app or its services resulting from this has been confirmed, and that at present it is not asking customers to change their password or take any other special steps.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: The company's own statement, repeated by The Record.

claim_text: McDonald's Japan says it is investigating and reporting to Japan's privacy regulator
summary: The company says it is investigating related systems, reporting to the Personal Information Protection Commission, and will update its notice if there is more to announce.
detail: It also says it will strengthen its security and work to prevent a repeat. The notice describes the regulator report as under way, not finished.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The company's own notice lists these steps; The Record reports the report to Japan's data protection authorities.

claim_text: No group has claimed it in anything we read
summary: Neither the company nor The Record names who was behind the access. The Record says there is no indication the incident is linked to earlier attacks on Japan's food and retail industries, such as one that affected KFC Japan.
detail: We did not open leak or dark-web sites.
label: Not established
why_it_supports: Neither source names anyone or mentions a claim of responsibility.

claim_text: McDonald's had 3,048 restaurants in Japan at the end of October 2026
summary: McDonald's Holdings Company (Japan) reports 3,048 restaurants at the end of October 2026 in its monthly restaurant count.
detail: The count is of restaurants. The company has not said how many people use its app.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The company's own investor page gives the month-end restaurant count.
